label_definition: Adjusted next-session open to adjusted T+2 close return in percent. Training target only; available after actual label receipt, never before T+2 16:00 Asia/Shanghai. Missing/delisted/nontradable cases retained with explicit reason, not silently dropped.
selection_policy: Freeze point-in-time universe including lifecycle and suspension status before each forecast. Use a common paired qualified cohort for all four groups, expanding 40-session train and 15-session validation with purged overlapping labels; reserve final 20 eligible observations untouched. Top 10 equal-weight simulated ranking, A-share T+1 and actual price-limit/lot/cost rules required for portfolio claims. Missing unit/definition/receipt evidence blocks fitting. Do not tune on the historical 2026-09-10 ablation or on this future holdout.
